```{r read and format}
# INPUT: aqua_traits.csv (relative to project folder)
traits<-read.csv('aqua_traits.csv')
species<-traits$Species.name
traits<-column_to_rownames(traits, var="Species.name")

traits<-traits[2:19]
head(traits)

traits$life_cycle=as.factor(traits$life_cycle)
traits$gametes=as.factor(traits$gametes)
traits$size=as.integer(traits$size)
traits$branching=as.factor(traits$branching)
traits$tissue_complexity=as.factor(traits$tissue_complexity)
traits$attachment=as.factor(traits$attachment)
traits$stype=as.factor(traits$stype)
traits$calcification=as.factor(traits$calcification)
traits$coenocyte=as.factor(traits$coenocyte)
traits$thickness=as.factor(traits$thickness)
traits$growth=as.factor(traits$growth)
traits$pneumatocysts=as.factor(traits$pneumatocysts)
traits$articulated=as.factor(traits$articulated)
traits$position_to_benthos=as.factor(traits$position_to_benthos)
traits$blades=as.factor(traits$blades)
traits$branch_shape=as.factor(traits$branch_shape)
traits$midrib=as.factor(traits$midrib)
traits$blade_category=as.factor(traits$blade_category)


```


```{r gower and groups}

gower_dist <- daisy(traits, metric = c("gower"))
groupings <- c(NA)
names<-c(NA)
for(i in 2:25){
  
  pam_fit <- pam(gower_dist,
                 diss = TRUE,
                 k = i)
  
  groupings[i] <-as.data.frame(pam_fit$clustering)
  names[i]<-(attributes(pam_fit$clustering))
  
}
names<-as.data.frame(species)
groupings<-as.data.frame(groupings)

nums<-c(1:25)
nums<-as.character(nums)
colnames(groupings)<-nums
groupings<-cbind(names, groupings)

pairwise.perm.manova(gower_dist, groupings[,3], p.method="none") 
pairwise.perm.manova(gower_dist, groupings[,4], p.method="none")
pairwise.perm.manova(gower_dist, groupings[,5], p.method="none")
pairwise.perm.manova(gower_dist, groupings[,6], p.method="none")
pairwise.perm.manova(gower_dist, groupings[,7], p.method="none")#fail

groups<-cbind(groupings[,6], traits)

```

```{r nmds and figure}

nmds=metaMDS(gower_dist, try=20, trymax=100)

stressplot(nmds)

NMDS1 = nmds$points[,1]
NMDS2 = nmds$points[,2]
group = groupings[,6]
NMDS = data.frame(NMDS1 = NMDS1, NMDS2 = NMDS2, group) 
NMDS$group=as.factor(NMDS$group)
levels(NMDS$group) <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")

write.table(NMDS, "groups.csv",row.names = T,sep=",")

species_colors<-c("#A7634D","#B37576", "#C18E9C","#E299A1", "#E5C1C1")

nmds_fig<-ggplot(NMDS, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color=group))+
  geom_point(size=2)+##separates overlapping points
    xlim(-.4, .4)+ylim(-.3, .2)+
stat_ellipse(type='t',linewidth =1.5, level=.5)+ ##LEVEL= confidence interval ellipses
  scale_linetype_manual(values=c(0,2))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position.inside=c(.9,.8), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=15),
        axis.text = element_text(size=15)
        )+
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors)

```

```{r SIMPER on transformed trait matrix}

traits_scaled <- traits

# scale numeric variable
traits_scaled$size <- scale(traits_scaled$size)

# then dummy encode
traits_dummy <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = traits_scaled)
group <- traits_all$aquacultured
all(rownames(traits_dummy) == rownames(use))

library(vegan)

simper_res <- simper(traits_dummy, group = group)
sim_sum <- summary(simper_res)

sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim_sum[[1]])

top50 <- sim_df[sim_df$cumsum <= 0.5, ]
top50

# Add trait names from rownames
top50$Trait <- rownames(top50)

# Clean up trait names
top50$Trait <- gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])", "\\1 \\2", top50$Trait)  # camelCase → spaced
top50$Trait <- gsub("_", " ", top50$Trait)                     # underscores → space
top50$Trait <- tolower(top50$Trait)

# Select key columns and rename for clarity
table_S2 <- top50 %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, average, cumsum) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Contribution = average,
    Cumulative = cumsum
  )

# Convert cumulative to percent and round nicely
table_S2 <- table_S2 %>%
  mutate(
    Contribution = round(Contribution, 3),
    Cumulative = round(Cumulative * 100, 1)
  )

# Print nicely
table_S2



```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)

# ---- Filter only aquacultured species ----
traits_aqua <- traits_all %>% filter(aquacultured == "y")

# Keep only traits columns (columns 2-19)
traits_aqua_traits <- traits_aqua[, 2:19]

# Convert characters to factors
traits_aqua_traits <- traits_aqua_traits %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Scale numeric traits
traits_aqua_traits$size <- scale(as.numeric(traits_aqua_traits$size))

# Identify traits with only 1 level
single_level_traits <- sapply(traits_aqua_traits, function(x) {
  if(is.factor(x)) nlevels(x) < 2 else FALSE
})
single_level_traits_names <- names(single_level_traits[single_level_traits])
single_level_traits_names
#> these are traits to remove

# Remove single-level traits
traits_filtered <- traits_aqua_traits %>%
  select(-all_of(single_level_traits_names))

# traits_filtered is now safe for dummy encoding
traits_filtered

traits_dummy <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = traits_filtered)

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

# Define the use categories
use_cats <- c("Food", "Feed", "Hydrocolloid")

# Initialize list to store results
simper_list <- list()

# Loop over each use
for(use in use_cats){
  # Only species with that use
  species_use <- traits_aqua %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[use]]) & .data[[use]] == 1)
  
  if(nrow(species_use) > 1){  # need at least 2 species for SIMPER
    # Match rownames in traits_dummy
    traits_use_dummy <- traits_dummy[rownames(traits_dummy) %in% rownames(species_use), , drop=FALSE]
    
    # Group factor (all 1s, but required by simper)
    group <- as.factor(species_use[[use]])
    
    # Run SIMPER
    sim_res <- simper(traits_use_dummy, group = group)
    sim_sum <- summary(sim_res)
    
    df <- as.data.frame(sim_sum[[1]])
    
    # Keep top ~50% cumulative contribution
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(UseCategory = use,
             Trait = rownames(df)) %>%
      filter(cumsum <= 0.5) %>%
      select(UseCategory, Trait, Contribution = average, Cumulative = cumsum)
    
    simper_list[[use]] <- df
  }
}

# Combine all results into one table
simper_use_table <- bind_rows(simper_list)

# Optional: view table
simper_use_table

simper_use_table_clean <- simper_use_table %>%
  # Remove the ...# suffix from trait names
  mutate(Trait = gsub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", Trait),
         # Round contribution and cumulative
         Contribution = round(Contribution, 3),
         Cumulative = round(Cumulative, 3)) %>%
  select(UseCategory, Trait, Contribution, Cumulative)

# View cleaned table
simper_use_table_clean


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Clean trait names and round values
simper_use_table_clean <- simper_use_table %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = str_replace(Trait, paste0(UseCategory, ""), ""),  # remove use prefix
    Trait = str_replace_all(Trait, "\\.\\.\\..*$", ""),       # remove ... suffix
    Contribution = round(Contribution, 3),
    Cumulative = round(Cumulative, 3)
  )

# Keep top 5 traits per UseCategory
simper_use_table_top5 <- simper_use_table_clean %>%
  group_by(UseCategory) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Contribution, n = 5) %>%
  arrange(UseCategory, desc(Contribution)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Function to format for Word
format_word_block <- function(df, usecat) {
  df_block <- df %>% filter(UseCategory == usecat)
  block <- paste0(df_block$Trait, "\t", df_block$Contribution, "\t", df_block$Cumulative)
  header <- paste0("UseCategory: ", usecat)
  c(header, block, "")  # empty line after each category
}

# Create Word-ready output
word_table <- c()
for(usecat in unique(simper_use_table_top5$UseCategory)) {
  word_table <- c(word_table, format_word_block(simper_use_table_top5, usecat))
}

# Print to console for copy-paste
cat(paste(word_table, collapse = "\n"))

simper_use_table_top5 <- simper_use_table_clean %>%
  group_by(UseCategory) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Contribution, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

traits_aqua %>%
  group_by(Hydrocolloid) %>%
  summarise(mean_size = mean(size, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_size = sd(size, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r multinomial regressions; look in TRAITS.3.10.2020.R for how to store the predictions}
#NMDS1 null--> McFadden pseudo-R2
#http://dwoll.de/rexrepos/posts/regressionMultinom.html#mcfadden-cox-snell-and-nagelkerke-pseudo-r2
# DescTools loaded in libraries chunk above

#make sure you've run chunk with all traits first to set correct df
dat<-cbind(NMDS, traits)
head(dat)

#NMDS 1

model.null<-nnet::multinom(NMDS1~1, data=dat) #null model
#create the null model
LL0   <- logLik(model.null)
xaxis.nmds1<-data.frame(NMDS1=seq(-0.4, 0.4, 0.01))

#lifecycle
NMDS1.life_cycle<-(nnet::multinom(life_cycle~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$life_cycle<-predict(NMDS1.life_cycle, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#gametes
NMDS1.gametes<-(nnet::multinom(gametes~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$gametes<-predict(NMDS1.gametes, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#size
NMDS1.size<-lm(size~NMDS1, data = dat) 
xaxis.nmds1$size<-predict(NMDS1.size, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response')
#branching
NMDS1.branching<-(nnet::multinom(branching~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$branching<-predict(NMDS1.branching, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#tissue complexity
NMDS1.tissue_complexity<-(nnet::multinom(tissue_complexity~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$tissue_complexity<-predict(NMDS1.tissue_complexity, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#attachment
NMDS1.attachment<-(nnet::multinom(attachment~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$attachment<-predict(NMDS1.attachment, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#stype
dat$stype<-as.factor(dat$stype)
NMDS1.stype <- glm(stype ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$stype<-c(predict(NMDS1.stype, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#calcification
dat$calcification<-as.factor(dat$calcification)
NMDS1.calcification <- glm(calcification ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$calcification<-c(predict(NMDS1.calcification, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#coenocyte
dat$coenocyte<-as.factor(dat$coenocyte)
NMDS1.coenocyte <- glm(coenocyte ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$coenocyte<-c(predict(NMDS1.coenocyte, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#thickness --only 1 and 4 as options
dat$thickness<-as.factor(dat$thickness)
NMDS1.thickness<-(nnet::multinom(thickness~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$thickness<-predict(NMDS1.thickness, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#growth
NMDS1.growth<-(nnet::multinom(growth~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$growth<-predict(NMDS1.growth, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#pneumatocysts
dat$pneumatocysts<-as.factor(dat$pneumatocysts)
NMDS1.pneumatocysts <- glm(pneumatocysts ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$pneumatocysts<-c(predict(NMDS1.pneumatocysts, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#articulated- all unarticulated
#position to benthos-- all flexible!!!
#blades
dat$blades<-as.factor(dat$blades)
NMDS1.blades <- glm(blades ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$blades<-c(predict(NMDS1.blades, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#branch shape
NMDS1.branch_shape<-(nnet::multinom(branch_shape~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$branch_shape<-predict(NMDS1.branch_shape, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')
#midrib
dat$midrib<-as.factor(dat$midrib)
NMDS1.midrib <- glm(midrib ~ NMDS1, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds1$midrib<-c(predict(NMDS1.midrib, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='response'))
#blade category
NMDS1.blade_category<-(nnet::multinom(blade_category~NMDS1, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds1$blade_category<-predict(NMDS1.blade_category, newdata=xaxis.nmds1, type='probs')

xaxis.nmds2$thickness<-predict(NMDS2.thickness, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='probs')
#growth
NMDS2.growth<-(nnet::multinom(growth~NMDS2, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds2$growth<-predict(NMDS2.growth, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='probs')
#pneumatocysts
dat$pneumatocysts<-as.factor(dat$pneumatocysts)
NMDS2.pneumatocysts <- glm(pneumatocysts ~ NMDS2, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds2$pneumatocysts<-c(predict(NMDS2.pneumatocysts, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='response'))
#articulated
dat$articulated<-as.factor(dat$articulated)
NMDS2.articulated <- glm(articulated ~ NMDS2, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds2$articulated<-c(predict(NMDS2.articulated, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='response'))
#position to benthos-- all flexible!!!
#blades
dat$blades<-as.factor(dat$blades)
NMDS2.blades <- glm(blades ~ NMDS2, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds2$blades<-c(predict(NMDS2.blades, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='response'))
#branch shape
NMDS2.branch_shape<-(nnet::multinom(branch_shape~NMDS2, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds2$branch_shape<-predict(NMDS2.branch_shape, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='probs')
#midrib
dat$midrib<-as.factor(dat$midrib)
NMDS2.midrib <- glm(midrib ~ NMDS2, data = dat, family = "binomial")
xaxis.nmds2$midrib<-c(predict(NMDS2.midrib, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='response'))
#blade category
NMDS2.blade_category<-(nnet::multinom(blade_category~NMDS2, data = dat)) 
xaxis.nmds2$blade_category<-predict(NMDS2.blade_category, newdata=xaxis.nmds2, type='probs')
```
